methods.name: backend.capabilities
methods.summary: Reports what the backend can do.

methods.name: entrypoint.call
methods.summary: Calls a workload's entrypoint in a transient microVM, admitted under a signed plan.

methods.name: machine.create
methods.summary: Persists a machine definition without booting it.

methods.name: machine.exec
methods.summary: Runs one non-interactive command in a machine.

methods.name: machine.inspect
methods.summary: Inspects one machine.

methods.name: machine.inventory
methods.summary: Lists every machine on this host with its dev/prod posture.

methods.name: machine.list
methods.summary: Lists machines, optionally filtered.

methods.name: machine.logs
methods.summary: Returns captured console output, base64-encoded.

methods.name: machine.rm
methods.summary: Removes a machine, stopping it first when needed.

methods.name: machine.logs.stream.close
methods.summary: Closes a captured-output stream. Idempotent.

methods.name: machine.logs.stream.next
methods.summary: Returns the captured output that has arrived.

methods.name: machine.logs.stream.open
methods.summary: Opens a stream over a machine's captured output, replayed then followed.

methods.name: machine.pause
methods.summary: Pauses a running machine, sealing a snapshot where the backend uses one.

methods.name: machine.prompt
methods.summary: Sends one prompt to a running machine's resident agent, granted by its plan, journaled, recorded encrypted and chain-audited.

methods.name: machine.reconfigure
methods.summary: Patches a machine's resources and relaunches it when running.

methods.name: machine.resume
methods.summary: Resumes a paused machine, refusing a replayed snapshot.

methods.name: machine.run
methods.summary: Boots a machine through the admitted local launch.

methods.name: machine.set_ttl
methods.summary: Sets or clears the time the idle reaper removes a machine at.

methods.name: machine.start
methods.summary: Boots a persisted machine definition.

methods.name: machine.stop
methods.summary: Stops a machine. Idempotent.

methods.name: session.call
methods.summary: Calls the entrypoint in a running session's microVM.

methods.name: session.info
methods.summary: Reports a session's record.

methods.name: session.start
methods.summary: Boots a warm session for a workload, admitted under a signed plan.

methods.name: session.stop
methods.summary: Stops a session and tears down its microVM.

methods.name: guest.cp
methods.summary: Copies a file between the host and the guest.

methods.name: guest.fs.list
methods.summary: Lists a directory in the guest.

methods.name: guest.fs.mkdir
methods.summary: Creates a directory in the guest.

methods.name: guest.fs.read
methods.summary: Reads a file from the guest, base64-encoded.

methods.name: guest.fs.remove
methods.summary: Removes a path in the guest.

methods.name: guest.fs.rename
methods.summary: Moves a path in the guest.

methods.name: guest.fs.stat
methods.summary: Stats a path in the guest.

methods.name: guest.fs.write
methods.summary: Writes a file in the guest, base64-encoded.

methods.name: guest.proc.kill
methods.summary: Kills a tracked guest process.

methods.name: guest.proc.list
methods.summary: Lists tracked guest processes.

methods.name: guest.proc.signal
methods.summary: Signals a tracked guest process.

methods.name: guest.proc.start
methods.summary: Starts a process in the guest.

methods.name: guest.proc.stdin
methods.summary: Writes a tracked process's stdin, base64-encoded.

methods.name: guest.proc.stream.close
methods.summary: Closes a process output stream. Idempotent.

methods.name: guest.proc.stream.next
methods.summary: Returns the process output that has arrived, and how it ended.

methods.name: guest.proc.stream.open
methods.summary: Opens a stream over a guest process's output.

methods.name: guest.proc.wait
methods.summary: Waits for a guest process to end, returning its output.

methods.name: telemetry.records
methods.summary: Reads one cursor-paged page of a machine's collected telemetry records.

methods.name: telemetry.status
methods.summary: Reports whether telemetry collection was provisioned for a machine and how its collector stands.
